mike: heads-up — interactive timeseries stutters badly when you drag/zoom on heavy dashboards (>200 series). Started hitting after yesterday's telemetry debounce rollout. can repro locally and on eu-prod canary :eyes:
priya: ugh. saw a couple reports early AM. can repro on /dash/wallets with canary. main thread spikes ~120ms per frame when brush moves
sam: do we have a stack or flame? is it parse/paint or JS work?
mike: looks like parse + blocking import. logs show huge synchronous parse in charts.bundle and `telemetry-client` eager init. snippet:
```
Error: long-task
  at parseFrames (charts.bundle.js:12:345)
  at initTelemetry (telemetry-client.js:8:90)
  at onLoad (dashboard.js:45:12)
  at Array.forEach (<anonymous>)
```
deploy-bot: Canary deploy 3f2a1b9 -> eu-prod started by priya at 09:12 UTC :rocket:
alex: interesting — that commit also flipped telemetry debounce from 300ms -> 50ms and enabled eager sampling. could be causing earlier init path.
priya: i pushed a quick diff to lazy-import telemetry on non-critical routes: `const telemetry = await import('telemetry-client')` in route loader. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/telemetry/1234 :thumbsup:
lina: can we revert the debounce change for the canary while we triage? SLOs are degrading (LCP up ~20% on dashboards).
sre-ops: rolling metrics now. if LCP keeps climbing we'll rollback. currently seeing a 22% increase in dashboard 75p on eu-prod-canary.
sam: another data point — sourcemap shows charts.bundle size jumped by ~120KB after metric tags were added to the renderer. maybe unrelated but worth checking bundling.
mike: repro steps i used: open /dash/wallets, enable timeseries overlay, drag zoom quickly across dense area. always repro within 3-4 drags.
alex: tried toggling `--bundle-splitting=false` on canary and jank reduced ~40% — suspect additional module hoisting caused larger main chunk which blocks parse.
priya: ok let's: 1) revert debounce change on canary 2) enable lazy import of telemetry 3) run canary with bundle-splitting flag off for perf test. i'll open rollback PR now.
sam: created issue #789 and assigned to eng-platform; adding trace links and screenshots.
sre-ops: thanks — i'll keep an eye on rollout and pause if it crosses threshold. ping me when PR merged.
mike: thanks folks. if someone can run a quick local A/B with telemetry lazy import vs eager that'd help isolate. i'm adding a small perf test script to reproduce. :coffee:
priya: PR opened https://git.internal/r/redwood/dddd/rollback-telemetry-debounce (diff includes lazy import). merging to canary in 10m unless objections.
lina: please add a changelog note and alert to customer-success in case any external dashboards experienced blips.
alex: FYI i captured a small playback via devtools that shows parse blocking timeline — will drop it in the issue.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy 3f2a1b9 rolled back at 09:42 UTC by automated SLO guard (LCP breach).
priya: rolled PR and canary now on 1a9f4c2 (lazy telemetry). monitoring. :pray:
